'''Ziroxin-12''' was a chemical poison developed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] for use in devastating massive populations during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Ziroxin-12 was produced in massive quantities in the [[Llanic system/Legends|Llanic system]], prompting a [[Battle of the Llanic system|Republic strike]] against the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] there.
